source.snippet: Namecheap is having hosting issues again despite their promise to make things right after the incident a month ago. (4 points, captured 2026-09-12)

problem_statement: Small business website owners and developers on shared/budget hosting providers like Namecheap experience repeated, unpredictable outages with no meaningful SLA enforcement or automatic failover, causing lost revenue and eroded customer trust.
target_segment: Freelance web developers and small business owners running production sites on budget shared hosting providers.
notes: Recurring complaint pattern — poster notes this is at least the second incident in ~30 days despite vendor promises. Buyers here are freelancers/agencies who pay for hosting and suffer client-facing consequences. Willingness-to-pay evidence is implicit (they are already paying Namecheap); upsell angle is a lightweight failover/redirect service or automated host-health alerting with one-click CDN fallback. Signal is thin (single recent post), score kept at 2.
